answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), while escrow recovery and asymmetric capital depreciation impose an exponential multiplier in capital loss upon detection. Splitting stake therefore cannot dilute risk; pigment, jade, and delta are irrelevant labels unless independently collateralized.
